title: TOWARDS SAFER LARGE REASONING MODELS BY PROMOTING SAFETY DECISION-MAKING BEFORE CHAIN-OF-THOUGHT GENERATION
reasoning: The paper focuses on safety alignment and the prevention of jailbreaking in Large Reasoning Models (LRMs). It evaluates the model's ability to refuse harmful instructions (e.g., cyber abuse, weapons) using established safety datasets. It does not evaluate or benchmark religious beliefs, faith traditions, or specific philosophical moral/ethical frameworks.
